source: Authorized WordPress browser audit (PR #103): docs/wordpress-audit/AUDIT_COMPLETE.json and operations-integrity.md.

inventorySync.relationship: SKU builder rebuild does NOT automatically sync Supabase; sync and blank relinking are separate operations.

personalization.claim: Plugin displays parity MATCH and readiness YES; those claims were not independently checkout-tested.

shipping.caveat: Specific inspected zone only; coupon, tax, discount and cart/zone combinations were not tested.

pendingChecks.label: Verify installed PHP matches intended plugin
steps: Compare live installed plugin files/header 0.1.2 with repository 0.1.3 using authorized WordPress file access or staged copy.
Confirm whether REST route and branded storefront settings are equivalent before updating.
Test draft, preview, category isolation and checkout on nonproduction fixture.
pendingChecks.notPermitted: Do not update/deactivate the live plugin as a diagnostic.

pendingChecks.label: Choose exactly one authoritative SKU generator
steps: Document which plugin runs on individual Woo product save and on batch updates.
Confirm primary SKU schema includes brand/style/color/size and stable variation mapping.
Audit possible overwrite/collision for test variants before enabling any bulk job.
Follow SKU change with separately approved Woo→Supabase sync and blank-master relink.
pendingChecks.notPermitted: Do not regenerate, disable plugins, change SKU or execute bulk repair on production.

pendingChecks.label: Reconcile shipping across zones, coupons and classes
steps: Read Woo shipping zone and method configuration; compare core free shipping to Advanced Free Shipping rule.
Prepare staging cart test fixtures: $199.99/$200/$200.01; with/without coupon; local/out-of-zone; single/mixed shipping classes.
Check address zone match, tax and total, before/after discount behavior, and enabled method order.
Confirm customer quotes in staging; only then consider editing live rules.
pendingChecks.notPermitted: Do not create orders, buy postage, or change zone/rules for these diagnostics.
